title: Recurring individual leakers
disclaimer: Archive-based reliability signal, not a guarantee. A person can be accurate on one claim and wrong on another; repeated coverage of the same post is not independent confirmation.

leakers.name: Steve Hemmerstoffer
leakers.note: Appears repeatedly behind early S22, S23 and S25 design renders. The archive treats CAD as useful shape evidence, not a final production blueprint.

leakers.name: Ice Universe
leakers.note: Frequently attributed across the S22, S23 Ultra and S27 records for camera, display, battery and chipset claims. Individual claims still need separate verification.

references.title: S23 Ultra camera and display reports

leakers.name: Evan Blass
leakers.note: The S25 archive records additional renders attributed to him, making him a notable source for official-looking pre-launch imagery rather than a general specification oracle.

leakers.name: Yogesh Brar
leakers.note: Named in S23 reporting for camera and chipset specifications. The archive keeps his claims distinct from later launch confirmation.

leakers.name: Ross Young
leakers.note: The S23 archive cites him for an early limited-color prediction. This is a narrower signal than a complete device specification leak.

leakers.name: Robin Quandt
leakers.note: The S23 archive attributes apparent Snapdragon marketing and comparison material to him. Material provenance matters more than the outlet repeating it.

leakers.name: Tron
leakers.note: Named by Notebookcheck in the early S22 Exynos/AMD and Snapdragon regional specification trail. The archive records the regional uncertainty rather than treating it as certainty.

leakers.name: Jukanlosreve
leakers.note: The S25 record attributes leaked S25+ hands-on images to this account, including the camera rings and US mmWave antenna.

leakers.name: Sonny Dickson
leakers.note: The S27 record attributes a wide camera-plateau image report to him. The archive treats image interpretation, such as possible Qi2 magnets, as unconfirmed.

leakers.name: Anthony
leakers.note: The S27 record attributes several early camera, display and chipset claims to this account, but the underlying posts were not independently preserved; it is listed for traceability, not endorsement.

references.title: S27 Ultra camera and display claims

leakers.name: Setsuna Digital
leakers.note: Credited by Gizmochina for the earliest S27 S Pen-slot rumor currently located in the archive. One early report is not enough to establish a reliability record.
